settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.shipping_text: We offer fast, reliable shipping on all orders. Most orders ship within 1-2 business days from our Portland studio.
settings.returns_text:
We want you to love your Aura & Oak products. If you're not completely satisfied, we accept returns within 30 days of delivery on unopened items in original packaging.

Used candles cannot be returned, but we stand behind our quality. If you experience any issues with your candle, please contact us and we'll make it right.
